hi,

i really need to sort out hiring the wexcombe regent for a film shoot - we want to pick it up on 26 march 2027 at 2.30pm and bring it back on sat 27 mar 2027 at 12:00. can you meet us at brackenridge manor and bring it there, then collect it from there afterwards? your website says the total comes to €564.00.

thanks,
milo corbyngton
